HIS metrics (unchanged)\n\n- **HIS_raw** $=1-|\\Delta|/|\\langle H\\rangle_{id}|$ (not gauge-invariant under $cI$)\n- **HIS_span** $=1-|\\Delta|/(\\lambda_{max}-\\lambda_{min})$ (primary)\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"f42e6810-1db2-4db6-abcc-9c10e3a13fe1","cell_type":"code","source":"def his_raw(h_id, h_re):\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    return float(\"nan\") if d < EPS else 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d\n\ndef his_span(h_id, h_re, span):\n    return 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / span\n\ndef z_diff(a, sa, b, sb):\n    s = math.sqrt(sa**2 + sb**2)\n    return float(\"nan\") if (s < EPS or math.isnan(s)) else (a - b) / s\n\ndef group_stats(counts, op, n):\n    labels = op.paulis.to_labels()\n    coeffs = np.real(op.coeffs)\n    vals, cnt = [], []\n    for bs, c in counts.items():\n        s = bs.replace(\" \", \"\")[-n:].zfill(n)\n        e = 0.0\n        for lab, w in zip(labels, coeffs):\n            par = 0\n            for i, ch in enumerate(lab):\n                if ch != \"I\" and s[i] == \"1\":\n                    par ^= 1\n            e += w * (1 - 2 * par)\n        vals.append(e)\n        cnt.append(c)\n    cnt = np.array(cnt, float)\n    shots = max(cnt.sum(), 1.0)\n    return np.array(vals), cnt / shots, int(shots)\n\ndef estimate_energy(groups_counts, groups_ops, n):\n    h, var = 0.0, 0.0\n    for counts, op in zip(groups_counts, groups_ops):\n        v, p, shots = group_stats(counts, op, n)\n        m = float(p @ v)\n        h += m\n        var += float(p @ (v**2) - m**2) / max(shots, 1)\n    return h, math.sqrt(max(var, 0.0))\n\nprint(\"métricas OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true},"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T16:25:21.497014Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T16:25:21.497466Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T16:25:21.510752Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T16:25:21.497432Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T16:25:21.509842Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"métricas OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":3},{"id":"5004bf64-61ce-4e48-b245-0b95650ab5b0","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 3. Hamiltonians T1 (MaxCut) & T5 (non-diagonal Pauli)\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"9e2d6fd5-6c0f-4a21-985b-a632be13cdb9","cell_type":"code","source":"def plabel(n, ops):\n    s = [\"I\"] * n\n    for q, l in ops.items():\n        s[n - 1 - q] = l\n    return \"\".join(s)\n\ndef maxcut_H(n):\n    t = [(\"I\" * n, 0.5 * (n - 1))]\n    t += [(plabel(n, {i: \"Z\", i + 1: \"Z\"}), -0.5) for i in range(n - 1)]\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t)\n\ndef random_pauli_H(n, seed):\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    t = []\n    for l in \"XYZ\":\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: l, i + 1: l}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.5))))\n        for i in range(n):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: l}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.4))))\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t).simplify()\n\ndef build_prep(kind, n, idle=None, qaoa=(0.8, 0.4), hea=None):\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)\n    if kind == \"T1\":\n        g, b = qaoa\n        qc.h(range(n))\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n            qc.rz(-g, i + 1)\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n        if idle:\n            idle(qc, \"cost\")\n        qc.rx(2 * b, range(n))\n        if idle:\n            idle(qc, \"mixer\")\n    else:\n        L = hea.shape[0]\n        for l in range(L):\n            for q in range(n):\n                qc.ry(float(hea[l, q, 0]), q)\n                qc.rz(float(hea[l, q, 1]), q)\n            for i in range(n - 1):\n                qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n            if idle:\n                idle(qc, f\"L{l}\")\n    return qc\n\ndef h_ideal(prep, H):\n    return float(np.real(Statevector.from_instruction(prep).expectation_value(H)))\n\ndef spectrum_span(H):\n    ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh(H.to_matrix())\n    return float(ev[-1] - ev[0]), float(ev[0]), float(ev[-1])\n\nN = N_LOGICAL\nbest, QAOA = None, (0.8, 0.4)\nH1 = maxcut_H(N)\nfor g in np.linspace(0.2, 1.2, 12):\n    for b in np.linspace(0.1, 0.6, 10):\n        e = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T1\", N, qaoa=(g, b)), H1)\n        if best is None or e > best:\n            best, QAOA = e, (float(g), float(b))\n\nT5_SEED, T5_H, T5_HEA, t5_best = None, None, None, -1.0\n_candidates = []\nfor s in range(0, 300):\n    H = random_pauli_H(N, s)\n    span, _, _ = spectrum_span(H)\n    if span < EPS:\n        continue\n    hea = np.random.default_rng(s).uniform(0, 2 * np.pi, size=(3, N, 2))\n    hid = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T5\", N, hea=hea), H)\n    cond = abs(hid) / span\n    _candidates.append((cond, s, H, hea, hid, span))\n    if cond >= COND_MIN and cond > t5_best:\n        t5_best, T5_SEED, T5_H, T5_HEA = cond, s, H, hea\n\nif T5_H is None:\n    _candidates.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])\n    if not _candidates:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"No se pudo construir H de T5\")\n    t5_best, T5_SEED, T5_H, T5_HEA, hid5_tmp, span5_tmp = (\n        _candidates[0][0], _candidates[0][1], _candidates[0][2],\n        _candidates[0][3], _candidates[0][4], _candidates[0][5]\n    )\n    print(\"WARN: ningún seed con cond>=%.2f; usando mejor cond=%.4f seed=%d\" % (\n        COND_MIN, t5_best, T5_SEED))\nelse:\n    hid5_tmp = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T5\", N, hea=T5_HEA), T5_H)\n    span5_tmp, _, _ = spectrum_span(T5_H)\n\nspan1, _, _ = spectrum_span(H1)\nspan5 = span5_tmp\nhid1 = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T1\", N, qaoa=QAOA), H1)\nhid5 = hid5_tmp\n\ndef z_groups(H):\n    terms = list(zip(H.paulis.to_labels(), np.real(H.coeffs)))\n    buckets = {\"X\": [], \"Y\": [], \"Z\": [], \"I\": []}\n    for lab, w in terms:\n        letters = set(lab) - {\"I\"}\n        if not letters:\n            buckets[\"I\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"Z\"}:\n            buckets[\"Z\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"X\"}:\n            buckets[\"X\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"Y\"}:\n            buckets[\"Y\"].append((lab, w))\n        else:\n            buckets[\"Z\"].append((lab, w))\n    groups = []\n    for basis in (\"X\", \"Y\", \"Z\"):\n        items = buckets[basis] + (buckets[\"I\"] if basis == \"Z\" else [])\n        if not items and basis != \"Z\":\n            continue\n        if not items:\n            items = buckets[\"I\"] or [(\"I\" * N, 0.0)]\n        op = SparsePauliOp.from_list([(lab, w) for lab, w in items])\n        groups.append(dict(basis=basis, op=op))\n    if not groups:\n        groups = [dict(basis=\"Z\", op=H)]\n    return groups\n\nHAM = {\n    \"T1\": dict(H=H1, h_id=hid1, span=span1, groups=z_groups(H1), kind=\"T1\", qaoa=QAOA, hea=None),\n    \"T5\": dict(H=T5_H, h_id=hid5, span=span5, groups=z_groups(T5_H), kind=\"T5\", qaoa=None, hea=T5_HEA),\n}\nprint(\"QAOA\", QAOA, \"| T5 seed\", T5_SEED, \"cond\", round(t5_best, 3))\nprint(\"T1 h_id=%.4f span=%.4f groups=%d\" % (hid1, span1, len(HAM[\"T1\"][\"groups\"])))\nprint(\"T5 h_id=%.4f span=%.4f groups=%d\" % (hid5, span5, len(HAM[\"T5\"][\"groups\"])))\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true},"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T16:25:21.512861Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T16:25:21.513165Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T16:25:30.085059Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T16:25:21.513140Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T16:25:30.084240Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"QAOA (0.8363636363636364, 0.37777777777777777) | T5 seed 130 cond 0.093\nT1 h_id=5.3600 span=7.0000 groups=1\nT5 h_id=-1.3652 span=14.6377 groups=3\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":4},{"id":"3af825e3-e623-4ffc-a267-e61275778182","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 4. obtained.\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"82b56da8-d824-4718-bfc4-a945f5e32d19","cell_type":"code","source":"def per_qubit_friction(cal_dict, n_phys):\n    fr = np.zeros(n_phys)\n    for q in range(n_phys):\n        # higher readout + gate error → higher friction\n        ro = float(cal_dict.get(q, {}).get(\"ro\", 0.02))\n        gx = float(cal_dict.get(q, {}).get(\"xerr\", 0.001))\n        fr[q] = min(1.0, 5.0 * ro + 50.0 * gx)\n    return fr\n\nclass SimDevice:\n    def __init__(self, M, tls_frac, stale_flip, time_drift, delta_good, delta_bad, seed=SEED):\n        self.M = M\n        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        self.bad = set(rng.choice(M, size=max(1, int(tls_frac * M)), replace=False).tolist())\n        self.stale_flip = stale_flip\n        self.time_drift = time_drift\n        self.delta_good = delta_good\n        self.delta_bad = delta_bad\n        self.rng = rng\n        self.t = 0\n        self.cal = self._mk_cal(stale=True)\n        self.live = self._mk_cal(stale=False)\n\n    def _mk_cal(self, stale):\n        cal = {}\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            base_ro = 0.01 + (self.delta_bad if q in self.bad else self.delta_good) * 0.05\n            base_x = 0.0005 + (self.delta_bad if q in self.bad else self.delta_good) * 0.002\n            if stale:\n                base_ro *= 1.0 + self.stale_flip * self.rng.random()\n                base_x *= 1.0 + self.stale_flip * self.rng.random()\n            cal[q] = dict(ro=base_ro, xerr=base_x)\n        return cal\n\n    def step(self):\n        self.t += 1\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            drift = 1.0 + self.time_drift * self.rng.normal(0, 1) * 0.1\n            self.live[q][\"ro\"] = min(0.2, max(1e-4, self.live[q][\"ro\"] * abs(drift)))\n            self.live[q][\"xerr\"] = min(0.05, max(1e-5, self.live[q][\"xerr\"] * abs(drift)))\n\n    def noise_model(self):\n        nm = NoiseModel()\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            ro = self.live[q][\"ro\"]\n            nm.add_readout_error(ReadoutError([[1 - ro, ro], [ro, 1 - ro]]), [q])\n            xe = self.live[q][\"xerr\"]\n            nm.add_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(min(0.5, 2 * xe), 1), [\"x\", \"sx\"], [q])\n        for a in range(self.M - 1):\n            e = depolarizing_error(0.01, 2)\n            nm.add_quantum_error(e, [\"cx\"], [a, a + 1])\n            nm.add_quantum_error(e, [\"cx\"], [a + 1, a])\n        return nm\n\nbackend = None\nsim_backend = None\ndevice = None\nfr_cal = fr_live = None\nn_phys = None\n\nif MODE == \"cpu\":\n    device = SimDevice(**SIM)\n    fr_cal = per_qubit_friction(device.cal, device.M)\n    device.step()\n    fr_live = per_qubit_friction(device.live, device.M)\n    n_phys = device.M\n    coupling = [[i, i + 1] for i in range(n_phys - 1)] + [[i + 1, i] for i in range(n_phys - 1)]\n    cm = CouplingMap(coupling)\n    sim_backend = AerSimulator(noise_model=device.noise_model(), coupling_map=cm, basis_gates=[\"rz\", \"sx\", \"x\", \"cx\", \"measure\", \"delay\", \"id\", \"barrier\"])\n    MOTOR[\"ojos\"] = {\n        \"active\": True,\n        \"detail\": \"SimDevice fr_cal mean=%.3f fr_live mean=%.3f M=%d\" % (\n            float(fr_cal.mean()), float(fr_live.mean()), n_phys),\n    }\n    print(\"SimDevice M=%d | fr_cal service = QiskitRuntimeService()\n    backend = service.backend(BACKEND_NAME)\n    n_phys = backend.num_qubits\n    props = backend.properties()\n    cal = {}\n    for q in range(n_phys):\n        try:\n            ro = props.readout_error(q)\n        except Exception:\n            ro = 0.02\n        try:\n            xe = props.gate_error(\"x\", [q])\n        except Exception:\n            xe = 0.001\n        cal[q] = dict(ro=float(ro), xerr=float(xe))\n    fr_cal = per_qubit_friction(cal, n_phys)\n    fr_live = fr_cal.copy()  # QPU: live probe = current properties snapshot\n    MOTOR[\"ojos\"] = {\n        \"active\": True,\n        \"detail\": \"backend=%s props snapshot fr mean=%.3f max=%.3f n=%d\" % (\n            BACKEND_NAME, float(fr_live.mean()), float(fr_live.max()), EQG motor — Reflejos (MORPH-path layouts) + arm table\n\nPath search on coupling graph; blacklist high-friction qubits when possible.\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"273c1f14-f1a2-4519-b28e-bf2228bf880b","cell_type":"code","source":"# coupling adjacency\nif MODE == \"cpu\":\n    edges = [[i, i + 1] for i in range(n_phys - 1)]\nelse:\n    edges = list(backend.coupling_map.get_edges())\n\nadj = defaultdict(list)\nfor a, b in edges:\n    adj[int(a)].append(int(b))\n    adj[int(b)].append(int(a))\n\ndef path_layouts(n_logical, blacklist, max_paths=30):\n    \"\"\"Reflejos: simple path layouts avoiding blacklist when possible.\"\"\"\n    bl = set(int(x) for x in blacklist)\n    found = []\n\n    def dfs(path):\n        if len(found) >= max_paths:\n            return\n        if len(path) == n_logical:\n            found.append(list(path))\n            return\n        last = path[-1]\n        for nxt in sorted(adj[last], key=lambda q: fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0):\n            if nxt in path:\n                continue\n            if nxt in bl and len(path) + 1 < n_logical:\n                # allow if no alternative later — still try\n                pass\n            if nxt in bl and any(n not in path and n not in bl for n in adj[last]):\n                continue\n            dfs(path + [nxt])\n\n    starts = sorted(range(n_phys), key=lambda q: fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0)\n    for s in starts:\n        if s in bl:\n            continue\n        dfs([s])\n        if len(found) >= max_paths:\n            break\n    if not found:\n        # fallback linear\n        found = [list(range(n_logical))]\n    return found\n\ndef score_layout(layout):\n    return float(np.mean([fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0 for q in layout]))\n\nblacklist = [q for q in range(n_phys) if fr_live[q] >= DD_FRICTION_THR]\npaths = path_layouts(N, blacklist)\npaths_sorted = sorted(paths, key=score_layout)\nLAYOUT_A = list(range(N))  # naive sequential\nLAYOUT_C = paths_sorted[0]\nif LAYOUT_C == LAYOUT_A and len(paths_sorted) > 1:\n    LAYOUT_C = paths_sorted[1]\n\nMOTOR[\"reflejos\"] = {\n    \"active\": True,\n    \"detail\": \"paths=%d blacklist=%s LAYOUT_C=%s score=%.3f\" % (\n        len(paths), blacklist[:8], LAYOUT_C, score_layout(LAYOUT_C)),\n}\nprint(MOTOR[\"reflejos\"][\"detail\"])\n\ndef dd_qubits_for(layout, fr):\n    return [q for q in layout if q < len(fr) and fr[q] >= DD_FRICTION_THR]\n\nARM = {\n    \"A0\": dict(layout=LAYOUT_A, dd=False, fr_mean=score_layout(LAYOUT_A)),\n    \"A\":  dict(layout=LAYOUT_A, dd=False, fr_mean=score_layout(LAYOUT_A)),\n    \"C\":  dict(layout=LAYOUT_C, dd=False, fr_mean=score_layout(LAYOUT_C)),\n    \"D\":  dict(layout=LAYOUT_C, dd=True,  fr_mean=score_layout(LAYOUT_C)),\n    \"E\":  dict(layout=LAYOUT_A, dd=\"cond\", fr_mean=score_layout(LAYOUT_A)),\n}\nfor a, v in ARM.items():\n    print(\"  %s: layout=%s dd=%s fr_mean=%.3f\" % (a, v[\"layout\"], v[\"dd\"], v[\"fr_mean\"]))\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true},"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T16:27:46.892770Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T16:27:46.893123Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T16:27:46.910355Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T16:27:46.893095Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T16:27:46.909459Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"paths=14 blacklist=[] LAYOUT_C=[7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0] score=0.111\n  A0: layout=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] dd=False fr_mean=0.111\n  A: layout=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] dd=False fr_mean=0.111\n  C: layout=[7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0] dd=False fr_mean=0.111\n  D: layout=[7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0] dd=True fr_mean=0.111\n  E: layout=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] dd=cond fr_mean=0.111\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":9},{"id":"fc7a595c-db54-451e-8f0d-38868ed3f538","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 7. This is evaluated **before** the workload jobs.\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"daee5169-0278-4c95-b5ed-2bd91f23165c","cell_type":"code","source":"def juicio_pre(fr_live_vec):\n    mean_fr = float(np.mean(fr_live_vec))\n    max_fr = float(np.max(fr_live_vec))\n    if mean_fr >= ABORT_FR_MEAN:\n        return dict(tipo=\"abortar\", reason=\"mean_fr=%.3f >= ABORT_FR_MEAN=%.3f\" % (mean_fr, ABORT_FR_MEAN),\n                    mean_fr=mean_fr, max_fr=max_fr)\n    return dict(tipo=\"continuar\", reason=\"mean_fr=%.3f < abort threshold\" % mean_fr,\n                mean_fr=mean_fr, max_fr=max_fr)\n\nplan0 = juicio_pre(fr_live)\nMOTOR[\"juicio\"] = {\n    \"active\": True,\n    \"detail\": \"tipo=%s | %s\" % (plan0[\"tipo\"], plan0[\"reason\"]),\n}\nprint(\"[Juicio PRE]\", MOTOR[\"juicio\"][\"detail\"])\nif plan0[\"tipo\"] == \"abortar\":\n    raise RuntimeError(\"[EQG] Juicio abortó PRE: \" + plan0[\"reason\"])\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true},"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T16:27:52.948831Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T16:27:52.949170Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T16:27:52.956811Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T16:27:52.949141Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T16:27:52.955856Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"[Juicio PRE] tipo=continuar | mean_fr=0.115 < abort threshold\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":10},{"id":"673f26ac-c320-4766-a159-48837af54b79","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 8. / 2.0\n            if half > 0:\n                new.x(qargs[0])\n                new.delay(half, qargs[0], unit=unit)\n                new.x(qargs[0])\n                new.delay(half, qargs[0], ])\n            tc2 = pm.run(tc)\n            added = int(tc2.count_ops().get(\"x\", 0)) - before\n            if added > 0:\n                return tc2, added\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n    try:\n        durs = _synthetic_durations(tc.num_qubits)\n        pm = PassManager([\n            ALAPScheduleAnalysis(instruction_durations=durs),\n            PadDynamicalDecoupling(\n hea=d[\"hea\"])\n    basis = d[\"groups\"][gidx][\"basis\"]\n    qc = prep.copy()\n    basis_change(qc, basis)\n    if MODE == \"cpu\":\n        tc = transpile(qc, sim_backend, use_dd:\n        qs = layout if info[\"dd\"] is True else dd_qubits_for(layout, fr_live)\n        tc, nadd = apply_dd_circuit(tc, tgt, qs)\n        _dd_pulses[arm] += nadd\n    return tc\n\ndef           gc.collect()\n        return out\n    from qiskit_ibm_runtime import SamplerV2\n    sampler = SamplerV2(mode=backend)\n    job = sampler.run([(tc, None, shots) for tc in tcs])\n    jid = getattr(data, key).get_counts()\n                    break\n                except Exception:\n                    pass\n        if c is None:\n            for key in data:\n                try:\n
